tasks.label: AIRI: Start and wait for debuggers
args: lock=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/airi-debug-start.lock; exec 9>"$lock"; if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then flock 9; fi; if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json/version >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9229/json >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "AIRI debuggers already ready"; exit 0; fi; if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker start airi-dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if ! docker exec airi-dev pgrep -f "[e]lectron-vite" >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker exec -d airi-dev setsid -f sh -c "exec airi-debug >/tmp/airi-debug.log 2>&1"; fi; else if pgrep -f "[e]lectron-vite" >/dev/null 2>&1; then true; elif command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then setsid -f sh -c "exec 9>&-; exec airi-debug >/tmp/airi-debug.log 2>&1" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; else nohup airi-debug </dev/null >/tmp/airi-debug.log 2>&1 9>&- & fi; fi; for i in $(seq 1 120); do if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json/version >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9229/json >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "AIRI debuggers ready"; exit 0; fi; sleep 2; done; echo "AIRI debuggers did not become ready"; exit 1

tasks.label: AIRI: Show AIRI app logs
args: if test -f /tmp/airi-debug.log; then tail -f /tmp/airi-debug.log; else docker exec airi-dev tail -f /tmp/airi-debug.log; fi
